notes: «قال ابن رافع حدثنا» names no teacher in the text, so Ibn Rafi's branch is written without one; «وقال الآخران، أخبرنا عبد الرزاق» converges the branches, and the names after it are the shared tail (rule 3).
«- واللفظ لابن رافع -» is an editor's gloss and is left out. Usama's account of the Prophet's ride is the matn; the Prophet is not a link.
